# traced pages (on the thumbs) 208.4-209.6 x 295.0-296.4 mm, p10-p90 -- spread 1.4 mm, allowed 10
#
# METHOD -- measured on the RAW levelled scans at 600 dpi, never on the graded page (the grade clips most of
# the paper to 255 and the signal is gone).  Each page's own TRACED PAGE BOX is the anchor:
# the block grid is 53 x 75 blocks of 4 mm centred on the traced page centre and masked to
# the traced page.  Paper per block = the mean RGB of its brightest 15 %.  The INK coverage
# is regressed OUT as a covariate rather than filtered out (log paper = c + page + v_row + h_col + b(ink)),
# b non-parametric over 24 coverage bins, and the field is read at b(ink = 0) = clean substrate.
# The four half-profiles are monotone outward from the page centre by construction and are
# normalised to a centre gain of exactly 1.0; the versos were mirrored into recto orientation
# before pooling, and r005_masters_sheet.py mirrors them back by page parity.
#
# TWO TERMS.  The profiles are the SHAPE of the browning within a page, one shape for the whole
# class.  The `page-gain NNN R G B` lines below are the `page` term of the same fit -- how browned
# THAT page is against the class's MEDIAN page, which is 1.0 by construction.  The front of a
# magazine is browner than its middle (air and light reach the outside of the stack): measured over
# SH8606 and SH8608, the raw paper cast (R-B) of the first ~15 % of the book against the middle is
# +2.64 and +2.47 DN, and the profiles alone removed only 30-55 % of it.  r005_masters_sheet.py
# multiplies the page's own scalar in on top of the profiles, through the same FIELD_ALPHA.  A page
# with no line of its own -- rejected, or not in this fit -- is corrected by the profiles alone.
#
# the fitted terms, per channel -- the ink covariate, and the spread of the per-page gain:
#   R: clean-paper level exp(c) = 211.1 DN; ink term b(ink) in DN at a 200 level: 0.00:+0.0 0.06:-2.6 0.15:-5.5 0.21:-7.4 0.26:-8.3 0.31:-9.4
#   R: per-page gain p0/p10/p50/p90/p100 0.9799 0.9870 1.0000 1.0321 1.0704 (1.0 = the class median page)
#   G: clean-paper level exp(c) = 184.9 DN; ink term b(ink) in DN at a 200 level: 0.00:+0.0 0.06:-2.2 0.15:-4.9 0.21:-6.6 0.26:-7.5 0.31:-8.5
#   G: per-page gain p0/p10/p50/p90/p100 0.9736 0.9821 1.0000 1.1277 1.2281 (1.0 = the class median page)
#   B: clean-paper level exp(c) = 172.1 DN; ink term b(ink) in DN at a 200 level: 0.00:+0.0 0.06:-1.9 0.15:-4.4 0.21:-5.9 0.26:-6.8 0.31:-7.8
#   B: per-page gain p0/p10/p50/p90/p100 0.9701 0.9787 1.0000 1.1656 1.3029 (1.0 = the class median page)
#
# half-page: 104.06 x 147.95 mm (median of the class's traced boxes, halved)
# centre-paper / ink-floor below are the class MEDIANS of the per-page anchors; a page that
# cannot measure its own falls back on them.
